name: Kaijago
bio:
Kaijago is a highly skilled tattoo artist, specializing in minimalist, fine line, and illustrative designs, offering clients exceptional and intricate works of art. While they have a self-admitted flaw in responding to messages, it's clear that their professionalism shines through in the stunning portfolio of tattoos created at The Studio Afflecks in Manchester. Clients can expect a meticulous and focused approach to each piece, ensuring a clean and refined result that captures their individual style.
